verdict.text: Fails to launch when built with the iOS 27 SDK.

findings.title: No scene configuration
findings.message: Info.plist has no UIApplicationSceneManifest, and AppDelegate does not implement application(_:configurationForConnecting:options:). Built with the iOS 27 SDK, the app stops at launch: "UIScene life cycle is required for apps built with this SDK".

fix.title: Adopt a scene delegate
steps: Add a SceneDelegate class (UIResponder, UIWindowSceneDelegate) that creates the window in scene(_:willConnectTo:options:).

Add UIApplicationSceneManifest to Info.plist with a UIWindowSceneSessionRoleApplication configuration whose UISceneDelegateClassName is $(PRODUCT_MODULE_NAME).SceneDelegate, or implement application(_:configurationForConnecting:options:).
Move the app delegate methods sdkbump lists under SCN003 to the scene delegate.

sources.title: Apple: Transitioning to the UIKit scene-based life cycle

findings.title: Window created in the app delegate
findings.message: AppDelegate creates the window with UIWindow(frame:). With a scene, UIKit does not show a window that belongs to no scene, and the app opens to a black screen.

fix.title: Create the window in the scene delegate
steps: In scene(_:willConnectTo:options:), create the window with UIWindow(windowScene:), set its root view controller and call makeKeyAndVisible().

findings.title: launchOptions[.url] is empty with scenes
findings.message: UIKit does not put this key in the launch options once the app uses scenes. Use connectionOptions.urlContexts in scene(_:willConnectTo:options:).

fix.title: Move it to the scene delegate
steps: Implement the scene delegate method named in the finding and move the code there.

findings.title: Window looked up through keyWindow
findings.message: keyWindow returns a key window across all connected scenes (deprecated in iOS 13).

fix.title: Find the window through the scene
steps: From a view or view controller, use view.window or view.window?.windowScene.
Elsewhere, pick the foreground UIWindowScene from UIApplication.shared.connectedScenes and use its keyWindow or windows.

findings.title: Window looked up through UIApplication.windows
findings.message: windows lists the windows of every scene (deprecated in iOS 15); use the windows of the relevant UIWindowScene.

fix.title: Find the window through the scene
steps: From a view or view controller, use view.window or view.window?.windowScene.
Elsewhere, pick the foreground UIWindowScene from UIApplication.shared.connectedScenes and use its keyWindow or windows.
